body.message:
I hope you’re doing well. I’ve just made a reservation for your villa and I wanted to ask if an early check-in would be possible. Ideally, I would like to check in around 12:00 or 13:00 if the villa is available.

Also, could you please send me the exact address and directions to reach the villa?

Thank you in advance, and I look forward to staying at your place.
